QuestInfo.name: [Fox Valley] The Reunion
QuestInfo.0: You know it is time to leave Fox Point Village since the problems there have been resolved, but what about Moonbeam? The villagers are no longer wary of you thanks to Maru, so you should go see Moonbeam before you leave.
QuestInfo.2: The foxes forgot you, but it still made you glad to see them again. It wasn't everything you'd hoped--especially with Moonbeam--but it was good see them well.
